headerDisplay: Receives events from an Ajax hub over SIA DC-09 and exposes them to HomeKit. In the Ajax app, point **Monitoring station** at this Homebridge server (see the README).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the alarm in the Home app.

accountId.title: Object number
accountId.description: The "Object number" configured in the hub's Monitoring station settings: 3 to 16 hexadecimal characters.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port the plugin listens on. Enter the same one on the hub. Allowed: 1 to 65535.

encryptionKey.title: Encryption key
encryptionKey.description: Optional. Same key as set on the hub. 16, 24 or 32 characters. When set, unencrypted messages are refused.

devices.title: Detectors
devices.description: Detectors to expose as HomeKit sensors. Trigger a detector once and the Homebridge log tells you its zone number.

model.title: Model
model.description: Shown in HomeKit, for example MotionProtect Plus.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: For example the "device ID" at the bottom of the device page in the Ajax app.

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.description: As shown in the Ajax app. Leave empty to show the version of this plugin.

areas.title: Groups
areas.description: Number of Ajax groups. With more than one, the alarm shows "Home" until every group is armed. Allowed: 1 to 9.

motionResetSeconds.title: Motion reset (seconds)
motionResetSeconds.description: Ajax reports a motion once. HomeKit shows it for this long. Allowed: 1 to 3600.

heartbeatTimeoutMinutes.title: Hub silence timeout (minutes)
heartbeatTimeoutMinutes.description: Report a fault when the hub sends nothing for this long. Needs "Periodic test" enabled on the hub, with a shorter interval. 0 disables. Allowed: 0 to 1440.

maxTimeSkewSeconds.title: Allowed clock difference (seconds)
maxTimeSkewSeconds.description: Messages carrying a timestamp further from this server's clock are refused. 0 disables the check. Allowed: 0 to 86400.

allowedAddresses.title: Allowed hub addresses
allowedAddresses.description: Optional. Only accept traffic from these IP addresses.

cloud.title: Commands from HomeKit (unofficial)
cloud.description: Lets HomeKit arm, disarm and switch to night mode, and reads the real state at startup. Uses the protocol of the Ajax mobile apps, which is not an official API: Ajax can change or block it, and its terms restrict reverse engineering. Use at your own risk, ideally with a dedicated Ajax account.

totpSecret.title: Two-factor secret (base32)
totpSecret.description: Only if the account uses an authenticator app.

spaceName.title: Space name
spaceName.description: Only needed when the account has several spaces. The Homebridge log lists them.

syncIntervalMinutes.title: State check (minutes)
syncIntervalMinutes.description: How often to read the real state from Ajax. SIA already reports changes as they happen, so a long interval is fine. 0 only checks at startup and after a command. Allowed: 0 to 1440.

discoverDevices.title: Discover detectors
discoverDevices.description: Expose the motion, door, smoke and leak detectors of your Ajax account that are not listed under Detectors, with the name Ajax gives them. A detector listed above always keeps your own name.

temperatureSensors.title: Show temperatures
temperatureSensors.description: Add a temperature sensor to the detectors that measure it. Unlike motion and contact sensors, Apple Home shows these as tiles.

clientVersion.title: Announced app version
clientVersion.description: Raise it if the log says Ajax no longer accepts this client.

deviceModel.title: Device name shown in the Ajax app
deviceModel.description: How this plugin names itself in the list of sessions of your Ajax account, so you can recognise it there.

deviceOs.title: System name shown in the Ajax app

hub.title: Hub information
hub.description: What HomeKit shows for the alarm. All optional.

model.title: Model
model.description: Shown in HomeKit, for example MotionProtect Plus.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: For example the hub ID shown in the Ajax app next to the space name.

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.description: As shown in the Ajax app. Leave empty to show the version of this plugin.
